svg.title: TCR (T-cell receptor)
svg.desc: A cutaway shows paired TCR alpha and beta recognition chains crossing the T-cell membrane beside separate CD3 signaling partners. Rose CDR3 and other contact loops face a peptide held by HLA on the target cell; no TCR peptide pocket is shown. Contact is not a safety or killing test.

g.text: No peptide pocket is drawn in the TCR.
Contact does not establish safe killing.
